messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — latency-service p99 exceeded threshold (p99 ~ 780ms over 5m). Triggered to infra-oncall.

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-5342. Primary: alex

alex: acked. looking now, grabbing traces + perf dashboard -> https://redwood.tools/dash/latency-service

maya: seeing APAC region spike, p95 creeping too. KV cache hit rate dropped ~40%.

sam: adding temporary capacity to the dedicated pool, and route APAC traffic to eu-west fallback.

sam: run:
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-dedicated --replicas=6 -n prod
redwood route update --service latency-service --region apac --fallback eu-west
```

alex: warming KV cache for top-100 prefixes now (pod exec + preload script).

lina: CS reports two enterprise customers saw timeouts ~10:18-10:26 UTC, collecting more details.

maya: after scale + cache warm, p95 -> 230ms, p99 -> 420ms in APAC; global p99 down to 380ms. keeping eyes for 15m.

alex: handing incident to maya for rotation. I'll be offline for 40m. escalation path same: pagerduty -> infra-sre.

maya: acknowledged handoff. will monitor and open RCA draft if stable. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-5342 status -> acknowledged by maya

incident-bot: Alert cleared — latency-service p99 back below threshold for 10m. Auto-close window started.

maya: confirmed stable for 20m, closing incident. customer outreach via CS queued.

lina: noted outreach sent to affected customers, logged in customer-impact doc.
